lines.say: This question came in the CA Foundation January 2025 exam.
Anil walks 5 km north. He turns left and walks 3 km. He turns left again and walks 5 km. What is the total distance he walked?
He ends up 3 km from the start, so the answer is 3 km. Right?
The right answer is 13 kms. Here's why.
Step one. Path first. North 5 km. Left turn means west, 3 km. Left again means south, 5 km.
Step two. The question asks total distance walked, not distance from the start.
Step three. Add every leg. 5 plus 3 plus 5 is 13 km.
The shortcut. Distance walked is the sum of all legs. Displacement is only the straight gap from the start. Here that gap is 3 km.

rows: Distance walked = sum of all legs
